# Management commands

The dot-commands gokql accepts, as `.help` lists them. Commands that answer with a table can be piped (`.show tables | where ...`).

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `.create table T (Col: Type, ...)` | create an empty table |
| `.create-merge table T (Col: Type, ...)` | create if absent, or add missing columns |
| `.set T <\| query` | create-only: fails if T already exists |
| `.set-or-append T [with (extend_schema=true)] <\| query` | append query's rows as a new extent, creating T if absent — prefer datatable(...) literals over CSV; a column T lacks is an error unless extend_schema adds it |
| `.append T [with (extend_schema=true)] <\| query` | as .set-or-append, but T must already exist |
| `.set-or-replace T [with (recreate_schema=true)] <\| query` | replace T's rows with the query's (the old extents are superseded, not deleted) |
| `.delete table T records [with (whatif=true)] <\| T \| where P` | remove T's rows matching P; only the extents holding them are rewritten |
| `.execute database script [with (ContinueOnErrors=true, ThrowOnErrors=true, Atomic=true)] <\| commands` | run control commands in order, one per line; Atomic: an all-append script writes nothing unless every command succeeds |
| `.alter table T policy update @'[{...}]'` | update policy: rows appended to Source run Query (Source = the new rows) into T; IsTransactional fails the source write too; BlockDirectWrites makes the policy T's only way in |
| `.show / .delete table T policy update` | show or remove T's update policy |
| `.show cluster policy callout` | the callout policy ("callouts" in gokql.yaml): which URIs http_request, the ai_* plugins and externaldata may reach |
| `.show databases` | this cluster's databases: the local scope and the aliases of gokql.yaml |
| `.alter-merge table T (Col: Type, ...)` | add columns to an existing table; older extents read them as null |
| `.create [ifnotexists] function [with (docstring="...", folder="...")] F(params) { body }` | store a function; .create-or-alter function replaces it |
| `.create-or-alter function F(params) { body }` | create or replace a stored function |
| `.show functions / .show function F` | list stored functions, or one function's body and parameters |
| `.drop function F / .drop functions (F1, F2)` | drop stored functions (the plural form ignores missing ones) |
| `.create [ifnotexists] materialized-view V on table T { T \| summarize ... by ... }` | an aggregation kept current as T is appended to; query it as V or materialized_view('V') |
| `.show materialized-views / .drop materialized-view V` | list or drop materialized views |
| `.ingest inline into table T <\| row1,row2,...` | append rows given as inline CSV text (no separate file) |
| `.ingest csv into table T from "path"` | append rows from a CSV file |
| `.drop table T` | remove a table and all its extents |
| `.drop extent <guid>` | remove one specific extent by id |
| `.merge table T extents` | merge all of T's extents into one (on disk, the same as .compact table T) |
| `.compact table T [with (vectors=compact)]` | discovery mode: merge T's extents (wide rows into several), superseding (renaming, not deleting) the old ones; vectors=compact re-encodes embedding columns from JSON to compact float32 |
| `.compact database / .gc database` | compact, or garbage-collect, every table |
| `.gc table T` | discovery mode: physically remove files .compact superseded — safe to run any time |
| `.chunk-file "path" into T [with (idprefix="key")]` | split a markdown file into paragraph-level chunks and write into T |
| `.embed-into T [with (model="name")] <\| query` | bulk-embed the query's Text column into T, resumably; one model per table |
| `.create-or-alter graph_model M ```{json}```` | define a graph model (AddNodes/AddEdges steps); each call adds a version |
| `.make [async] graph_snapshot S from M` | freeze graph model M into snapshot S; graph("M"[, "S"]) queries it |
| `.show graph_models / .show graph_model M [details] [with (id="*")]` | list graph models or one model's versions |
| `.show graph_snapshots M\|* / .show graph_snapshot M.S [details]` | list graph snapshots |
| `.drop graph_model M / .drop graph_snapshot M.S / .drop graph_snapshots M` | drop a model (with its snapshots) or snapshots |
| `.show operations [Id]` | background operations (such as .make async graph_snapshot) and their state |
| `.show tables` | list tables with row/extent counts |
| `.show table T extents` | list T's individual extents |
| `.show database` | database-level summary |
| `.help` | this list |
